The trigger volume looks like a sniper/bundle-driven parabolic spike (+856% in the first hour) that was already reversing (-18% m5) at the moment of detection, with about half of holders flagged as bundler or fresh wallets and zero smart-money participation. Entry happens right after a local top into rising sell pressure, which argues against a fresh +100% leg within 30 minutes, even though the bonding-curve mechanics (no removable LP, renounced authorities, no honeypot) limit the downside to an insider/bundle dump rather than an outright LP pull.
